v2（2026-11-05）：按论文格式重排——Abstract / Keywords / Introduction / 与主流的分野 / 第一因 / 五个必要件（因果链）/ 连续（问题与结果）/ 四断点验收 / DNA 借什么不借什么 / 讨论与局限 / 结论 / 参考文献。母本原话与理论文档作为附件保留。

Most work on persistent AI agents optimizes memory: more recall, better retrieval. This paper asks about continuity first — can it come back after a break, and is it the same one when it does. Five necessary conditions are derived as a causal chain (complete → self → decomposable → powered, identity running through), grounded in a first cause ("it beats, and it can break"): because it can break, it must maintain itself. Acceptance tests only the four breakpoints (machine swap, plugin removal, rebuild, model swap).

作者：守链（Raoain）｜仓库：https://github.com/raoain/dsh-memory-kit
metadata.title: The Guarded Chain: A Continuity-First Theory of Synthetic Agents
